Name: Exotic Animals
Author: DGlaky
Description:
This mod adds four special variants of existing farm animals that can be purchased from Marnie's shop. These animals include the traveling merchant's purple pig, a green merchant goat, pink rabbits, and void cows. Each animal can produce special goods that can be used in various recipes to create all new items such as void pizza and exotic eggnog. Shane's blue chickens will also produce blue eggs rather than the brown or white eggs. Recipes for the various food items can be obtained through friendship with different villagers.
